findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_catalog, facilitator-dry-run, payment-receipt-auditor, bazaar-check, defi-base-snapshot, base-allowance-scan, base-tx-explain, phantom-seller-scan, url-fingerprint, agent-lead-pack, base-balance, url-extract, web-search, web-extract, image-ocr, red-flag-scan, offer-score · Private data: image-ocr · Public sink: facilitator-dry-run, payment-receipt-auditor, bazaar-check, phantom-seller-scan, image-ocr, red-flag-scan, offer-score · Destructive: facilitator-dry-run, payment-receipt-auditor.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_catalog, facilitator-dry-run, payment-receipt-auditor, bazaar-check, defi-base-snapshot, base-allowance-scan, base-tx-explain, phantom-seller-scan, url-fingerprint, agent-lead-pack, base-balance, url-extract, web-search, web-extract, image-ocr, red-flag-scan, offer-score · Private data: image-ocr · Public sink: facilitator-dry-run, payment-receipt-auditor, bazaar-check, phantom-seller-scan, image-ocr, red-flag-scan, offer-score · Destructive: facilitator-dry-run, payment-receipt-auditor

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
